name: akoya_request-fieldprimer
_comment: Isolated followup deploy (S258) for the single Workbench Proposal-tab Field Primer Memo field. Lives in its own wave so `apply-dataverse-schema --wave=2-fieldprimer` creates ONLY this field. Re-running the full wave2 would ALSO try to create the drifted `wmkf_appreviewersuggestion_honorariumrequest` relationship (prod has the honorarium lookup under a different SchemaName, so ensureLookupRelationship would create a duplicate) — hence isolation. Field naming follows the v3 wmkf_ai_<concept> rule. Catalogued in docs/atlas/dataverse-akoya-request.md and docs/WORKBENCH_PROPOSAL_TAB_BUILD_PLAN.md.

attributes.description: Workbench Proposal-tab Field Primer: JSON envelope of the staff-facing field primer for this proposal's research field (field_overview, subareas, key_methods, frontiers, communities, venues, experts with OpenAlex grounding, proposal_placement, caveats) plus provenance (model/runId/promptName/promptVersion/generatedAt). Written by the field-primer route on PD-triggered generation; see docs/WORKBENCH_PROPOSAL_TAB_BUILD_PLAN.md. Staff orientation only — NOT a reviewer-candidate source. JSON payload: parse, don't flatten (documented exception to flat-fields, like wmkf_ai_ReportGoalsAssessment).
